shots.headline: Know what each job earned
shots.sub: One row per print job. Filament, energy, wear, labour and channel fees are calculated, then total cost, profit and margin. Google Sheets and Excel.

shots.headline: Profit per month, per job
shots.sub: Monthly P&L sums revenue, each cost line, fees, hours, grams and the failure rate from the Jobs tab; 24 months from any start.

shots.headline: Track failures too
shots.sub: Status Queued, Printing, Done or Failed with a reason. A failed job keeps its cost at zero revenue and feeds the monthly failure rate.

shots.headline: Fees per channel, editable
shots.sub: Etsy 6.5% + 3% + $0.25 + $0.20 listing, Shopify, eBay, direct and two custom rows. Offsite-ads orders add the ads % on top.

settings.caption: Settings
settings.note: fee table: transaction %, payment % and fixed, listing fee

jobs.caption: Jobs
jobs.note: channel fees per job, offsite ads included when marked Yes

shots.headline: Google Sheets and Excel 2016+
shots.sub: No macros, no add-ons, formulas you can inspect.
notes: Open the .xlsx in Excel, or upload it to Google Drive and open with Sheets.
Sheets are protected against accidental edits; unprotect with no password.
Plain formulas only: IF, VLOOKUP, IFERROR, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, DATE.
shots.formula_caption: Jobs!W5, the profit cell: price charged minus total cost minus channel fees

faq.a: Instant download after purchase: one .xlsx file and a Read-Me-First PDF.
Both. Excel 2016 or newer, or upload to Google Drive and open with Sheets. No macros or add-ons.
200 job rows and a 24-month P&L from any start month; five sample jobs are included to overwrite.

faq.q: Is this tax or financial advice?
faq.a: No. It is a record of your own jobs and costs; taxes, refunds and overheads are yours to add.
Updated versions are added to the same listing; re-download from your Etsy purchases at no charge.
